scope: Proposition 6.21 (The restricted induction) of the manuscript “Finite ordinary minimal model programs on compact Kähler fourfolds” (preprints/Finite-ordinary-minimal-model-programs-on-compact-Kahler-fourfolds-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 056 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b1b9511572d6c717), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 45. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let Td denote termination of existing ordinary rational klt programs in dimension at most d, including the bound on divisorial steps. The following implications hold: Cd−1 =⇒ Cd,big, Cd,big + Bd−1 + Gd−1 =⇒ Bd (2 ≤ d ≤ 4), Bd + Td =⇒ Gd (d ≤ 3), Bd + Cd−1 + Td =⇒ Cd (d ≤ 3). Consequently B4 holds. No assertion G4 or C4 is required.
